label: Bible Study
prompt: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he _____ on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
verse: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
note: The first sabbath — God rests on day seven, not from weariness but because the work was finished.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the _____.
verse: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
note: The Song of the Sea begins on the far shore: horse and rider thrown into the sea.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou _____: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
verse: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
note: Mark notes Jesus looked at the rich man and loved him — before naming the one thing he lacked.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the _____ was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
verse: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
note: The queen of Sheba came skeptical and left saying the reports were too small; Jesus cites her in Matthew 12.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that _____ by the stuff: they shall part alike.
verse: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
note: David's rule after Ziklag: those who guard the supplies share equally with those who fight. Every church's behind-the-scenes verse.
